title: Fracture radiographs: wrist, ankle, shoulder, knee and hip with expert outlines
description: Five musculoskeletal radiographs from FracAtlas, each with one fracture outlined by the dataset's annotators (two expert radiologists and an orthopedist): distal forearm/wrist, ankle, proximal humerus, proximal tibia and proximal femur. Full-resolution 8-bit JPEGs as distributed; no pixel spacing or orientation tag in the source.

FracAtlas: A Dataset for Fracture Classification, Localization and Segmentation of Musculoskeletal Radiographs. Sci Data. 2023;10:521. doi:10.1038/s41597-023-02432-4. Data: figshare doi:10.6084/m9.figshare.22363012.v7
sources.accessNote: FracAtlas.zip read member-by-member (HTTP Range, CRC-32 checked) from figshare; COCO_fracture_masks.json and dataset.csv from the same archive. No login.

referenceTargets.label: Fracture (FracAtlas expert outline)

provenanceDetail.method: Fracture polygon drawn manually in makesense.ai with the help of two expert radiologists and an orthopedist (Abedeen et al. 2023); COCO annotation id 0, converted from pixel-corner to pixel-centre coordinates (-0.5 px).
provenanceDetail.note: COCO bbox [1242.3, 929.1, 273.3, 147.3]; dataset.csv: hand, fracture_count 1, no hardware, frontal view.

referenceTargets.unassessedNote: Only the fracture is outlined; alignment, joint involvement and soft tissues are not referenced.
referenceTargets.teachingNote: The outline marks the fracture region drawn by the dataset's annotators; it is not a measurement of displacement.
